review.summary: Round 4 reviews 86c5159, which fixes two inconsistencies that the AI client noted during the developer's manual end-to-end check: the revenue examples used percentPerPeriod 1.5 while the text gives 1.53 for 20 % a year, and the rounding rule said 2 decimals for money while the revenue examples round to whole units. Both revenue examples now use 1.53, which compounds to about 20 % a year. The rounding rule now gives 0 decimals for counts, people and money totals and 2 for prices, other small money amounts and ratios. Every example in both skills follows it, and only the percentage example sets clampMax 100. A quick pass over noise, ar1, seed, peak and trend advice found no other contradiction between the rules and the examples. The skill tests, including the engine run of the model-building example and generation of every spec, and the plugin validation pass. Nothing new was found.
